data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Yandex AppMetrica Push SDK, enabling push notifications with targeting and analytics.
data.what_it_does: It allows sending push notifications to users segmented by AppMetrica data, supports A/B testing, scheduling, and detailed analytics. The plugin requires the AppMetrica SDK to be activated first.
use_when: need push notifications with advanced targeting and analytics
require A/B testing or scheduling of pushes
avoid_when: using another push provider like Firebase Messaging or OneSignal
project does not use AppMetrica SDK
weaknesses: iOS UIScene conflict requires specific handling
data.setup_notes: Add appmetrica_plugin dependency, activate AppMetrica with API key, activate AppMetricaPush, listen to tokenStream, ensure iOS UIScene configuration if using Flutter 3.41+

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides push notifications with Firebase Cloud Messaging, widely used and supported across platforms

alternatives.name: flutter_local_notifications
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers local notification handling and basic push features without requiring AppMetrica
